I have translated the Python `duplicate_chars` program into a complete Lean 4 formalization at [41_duplicate_chars.lean](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean) and verified that it compiles cleanly (`lake env lean Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean` exits with code 0, with all theorems proven without `sorry`, `admit`, `native_decide`, or extra axioms).

### Summary of Formalization ([41_duplicate_chars.lean](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean))
- **Functional Implementation**: [dupList](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L19-L21) and [duplicate_chars](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L24-L25) duplicate each character of the input string in order, with unit tests ([lines 27–40](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L27-L40)) and precondition [Pre](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L46).
- **Properties & Theorems**: Stated and proved 14 specification properties (plus 12 structural helper lemmas on `dupList`):
  - [empty_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L148-L154) / [isEmpty_iff_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L157-L163): Empty input/output behavior.
  - [length_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L166-L172) / [even_length_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L175-L181): Output length is `2 * s.length` and always even.
  - [flatMap_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L185-L189): Character list equals `s.data.flatMap (fun c => [c, c])`.
  - [even_index_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L192-L197), [odd_index_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L200-L205), [adjacent_pair_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L208-L213), and [getElem_dup_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L217-L241): Exact character indexing at `2 * i` and `2 * i + 1`.
  - [count_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L244-L249) and [mem_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L252-L257): Character multiplicity doubling and membership preservation.
  - [reverse_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L260-L264), [append_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L267-L276), and [injective_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L279-L292): Commutation with reversal, homomorphism over string append, and injectivity.
- **Post-condition, PBTs, and Correctness**: Defined [Post_prop](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L297-L309), added Plausible and bounded PBTs for every property and `Post_prop` ([lines 311–384](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L311-L384)), and proved [correctness_thm](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L389-L401).
- **Imperative Implementation & Equivalence**: Implemented [duplicate_chars_imp](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L406-L411) using `Id.run do` with mutable state, tested it, and proved functional-imperative equivalence in [equivalence_thm](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L448-L449) via the loop invariant [foldl_push_twice](file:///home/user/lean_project/Veribench/41_duplicate_chars.lean#L434-L444).
